sun.virgo: turns our attention to the daily rituals and systems we rely on, helping us see which support us and which have become too rigid, demanding, or punishing
sun.aries: puts more emphasis on starting, acting, and finding out what works by doing it
sun.taurus: slows the pace enough to notice what is worth keeping, building, or spending on
sun.gemini: makes questions, conversation, and new information harder to ignore
sun.cancer: brings more attention to home, care, family, and what you want to protect
sun.leo: makes it easier to put your name on the work and let yourself be seen doing it
sun.libra: puts more attention on agreements, tradeoffs, and decisions that affect more than one person
sun.scorpio: makes it harder to ignore what has been avoided, hidden, or left unresolved
sun.sagittarius: makes the bigger question, the farther trip, or the next thing to learn more compelling
sun.capricorn: puts the focus on responsibility, deadlines, and what you are willing to build over time
sun.aquarius: makes it easier to see the system behind the problem and question rules that no longer help
sun.pisces: softens the pace enough for imagination, compassion, and unfinished feelings to have more room

moon.cancer: brings more attention to home, family, and whether the care we give is coming back to us
moon.aries: makes reactions faster and harder to hide than usual
moon.taurus: makes comfort, familiar routines, and a slower pace more appealing
moon.gemini: makes it easier to talk through a feeling, ask another question, or change your mind
moon.leo: makes appreciation land harder and being overlooked harder to shrug off
moon.virgo: turns vague unease into a task, a list, or something concrete to fix
moon.libra: makes fairness, tone, and the give-and-take between people easier to notice
moon.scorpio: makes trust, privacy, and what is not being said harder to ignore
moon.sagittarius: makes space, movement, and a bigger perspective feel more necessary
moon.capricorn: makes it easier to handle what has to be done before talking about how it feels
moon.aquarius: makes a little distance useful for seeing the pattern behind the mood
moon.pisces: softens focus and making rest, imagination, and the atmosphere around you harder to tune out
